applies_why: The judge text resolves an Acts 2:30 link by comparing the defender's and challenger's chains and finding neither chain forces the other, which is the chain-against-chain situation the rule governs.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: The phrase 'by footing, never verse by verse' could mean either an overall chain-support assessment or a verse-by-verse tally; the judge's 'neither chain forces the other' reads as an overall chain comparison.
why: The judge weighed the competing chains as chains and did not decide by requiring a single contrary verse or by isolating verses.
